title: haplopappus venetus var. hartwegii
intro: Haplopappus venetus var. hartwegii, commonly known as the Hartweg's golden aster, is a perennial plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as its ability to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Haplopappus venetus var. hartwegii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
